item.title: Rhodes
item.description:
A unicorn. Beautiful and terrible.

Beyond

The beauty is an illusion over a true rotting form. His weapon is paradise – temptation, never force; he holds that a soul coerced does not count. He deploys beasts as enforcers, lies to Eri about her mother, and cranks the drain to punish her. Issah kills him; the illusion collapses to rot.

item.title: The Obelisk
item.description:
Obsidian. It stands on an outcrop near the summit, its tip exceeding the peak.

Beyond

It is a prism. The unicorns built it. Everything the lenses take passes through it and comes out as light.

item.title: The Turning
item.description:
The story everyone is taught: the rainbows are the gods’ gift of peace.

Beyond

It is propaganda. The rainbows are the visible exhaust of the drain.

item.title: The Unicorns
item.description:
The parasites.

Beyond

They drain life through lenses into the obsidian obelisk, which prisms it into the rainbows. They rule by divide-and-conquer – they set the tribes and creatures against each other and directed the Vessel People to break the dragons – and by manufactured consent: controlled schooling and the Turning myth.
